text: And this is why Raphinha's move matters to more than a partnership. Pedri can find the runner from deep. Rodri can stabilize the midfield and release the next pass. Yamal can create or finish. The defenders cannot assign all their attention to one channel because Barcelona can begin an attack in another. Even the scoreline at Sevilla tells an incomplete story. It was their lowest league goal total of the season to that point, yet they still made the decisive moments look different: a run through the middle, a header from the right, and a finish after a threaded pass. The value is variation. Flick does not need the same combination to work three times. He needs the opponent to keep adjusting until one of those routes opens. And in Europe, that repeated decision-making can be exhausting.
